title: Short intervals for the Romanoff-type sumset
summary: Let $X$ be large and let $\mathcal{P}$ denote the set of primes. Fix positive real parameters $r_1,\dots,r_s$ and a parameter $λ\geqslant 1$ determined by a balancing relation, and let $\mathcal{A}_λ(X)\subset[1,2X]$ be the associated lacunary set generated by sums of powers of $2$ with polynomially growing exponents. Set $\mathcal{S}_λ:=\mathcal{P}+\mathcal{A}_λ(X)$. Fix $\varepsilon>0$, choose $θ$ with $2/15+\varepsilon<θ<0.99$, and set $h=X^θ$.
